subject: Post-demo synthesis + PoA: proposed POC roadmap and success criteria
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@lumencare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo synthesis + PoA: proposed POC roadmap and success criteria

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for the demo time today. Quick synthesis and proposed plan-of-action so we have shared expectations before we draft the formal POC doc:

Summary of needs (from today)
- Validate model quality on clinical note summarization (90% recall on provider key facts)
- Ensure latency under 350ms p50 for single-note runs inside your VPC gateway
- Confirm data handling: no patient PII leaves your VPC; logs retained per your 30-day policy
- Measure throughput for batch ingestion (target 500 notes/min sustained)

Proposed POC scope (3-week technical sprint)
1) Week 1: environment setup — VPC connectors, sample dataset ingestion, test harness
2) Week 2: model tuning & eval — run standard holdout set, iterate prompts, collect metrics
3) Week 3: reliability & scale — throughput runs, latency SLO validation, KV/prefix caching exercise

Success criteria (what will define a pass)
- Quality: >= 0.90 recall on the provider-fact set and no major hallucination classes reported
- Latency: p50 < 350ms, p95 < 800ms under representative load
- Cost envelope: projected token cost per 1k notes within your target range (we'll baseline during week 1)
- Security/compliance: SOC2 snapshot + KMS integration validated

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood: Soojin — POC owner & customer-facing coordination; Marcus — infra & scale testing; Neha — security/compliance pack
- Lumencare: Erin — product/POC sponsor; procurement contact for contract steps (cc'd)

Attachments: Lumencare-POC-proposal.pdf (first-pass scope & test datasets)

Immediate asks / next steps
- Erin: please confirm the success criteria above and add any missing KPIs (throughput, sample size, decision gate owners)
- Lumencare procurement: please confirm any mandatory legal checkpoints (NDA, DPA) and preferred DocuSign contact
- Redwood: we'll prepare a short milestone plan + roles spreadsheet and circulate by EOD tomorrow

Proposed exec readout windows (for final decision): week of July 12 — two 30-min slots we can hold for your execs (we can tighten to July 15 if that works better)

If that aligns, I'll lock the kickoff for next Tuesday (06/22) and circulate the detailed runbook.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-demo synthesis + PoA: proposed POC roadmap and success criteria

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear recap and proposed plan. A few clarifications from our side:

- Throughput: the 500 notes/min target looks right but can we include a 1k/min burst target for peak simulations (15m windows)?
- Quality baseline: we'll provide the provider-fact set (anonymized) but want to add a secondary check for clinical omission rate — would like to see that metric included in the success criteria
- Security: SOC2 is a must. Can you include a brief snapshot of which evidence items you can provide immediately (control mapping + auditor letter or attestation)?

Procurement note (cc): once success criteria are agreed, we will need an initial SOW and standard PO terms. Also confirm if Redwood requires a signed DPA or your standard terms already include data commitments. We prefer DocuSign for any PO/SOW execution.

I agree to kickoff next Tuesday (06/22) pending the runbook. For the exec readout, July 15 is preferable on our side — please hold that day.

Thanks —
Erin
Erin Walsh
Head of Product, Lumencare
erin.walsh@lumencare.com | +1 (646) 555-3344

Thanks — good notes. Quick internal alignment and actions so we don't have ambiguity once the kick-off hits: 

Internal assignments (confirmed)
- Marcus (me): infra, VPC connector, perf harness, run throughput/latency experiments
- Neha: security/compliance lead — prepare SOC2 snapshot, KMS integration checklist, and DPA pointer
- Soojin: POC owner, success-metrics tracker, customer comms and runbook owner

Evaluation plan (technical)
- Baseline: ingest Lumencare sample set (n=1k anonymized notes) and run initial model against holdout to produce baseline metrics (W1)
- Tuning loop: 3 prompt iterations + small parameter sweeps to optimize recall & omission rates (W2)
- Load tests: 1k/min 15m bursts + 500/min sustained 1h runs for throughput stability, collect p50/p95 latency (W3)
- Reporting: nightly runbook updates pushed to shared Drive folder; final readout deck + artifact package for exec review

Deliverables and dates
- 06/18 EOD: Roles spreadsheet and milestone plan (see attachment: POC-roles-owners.xlsx)
- 06/22: Kickoff + environment access validation
- 07/08 or 07/15: Final technical readout to Lumencare execs (soojin — Erin prefers July 15)

Compliance note: Neha, can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts we can share by next Friday? If we need a formal security questionnaire response, let us know and we can prioritize the SAQ template.

Procurement / Legal: Soojin — procurement asked for an SOW + initial pricing band ahead of the kickoff; I'll draft a short SOW stub we can iterate on and drop into the Drive link.
